name: beegame-interaction-contracts
description: Implement or diagnose player-control mapping and camera-relative movement, or resolve a concrete screen/XR control-feasibility question. Listing GDD inputs alone does not require control implementation. 中文：控制实现与诊断、镜头相对移动、触控与XR输入可行性。

name: bgs-imagegen
description: Generate or edit raster assets for BGS projects, including reference boards, illustrations, sprites, textures and transparent cutouts, using available ChatGPT image generation or the configured user/platform image API. Use existing editable vector or code assets for tasks better served by those formats.

name: evidence-before-completion
description: Match design, revision, fix or delivery claims to actual source versions, checks and observations. Use for completion evidence, not project planning or an automatic review stage. 中文：完成依据、原文核查、修订验证、验收证据。

name: game-art-director-expert
description: "Establish or repair game art direction: composition, visual style, color, lighting, materials, and VFX. Use for visual quality, not technical import or UI behavior alone. 中文：游戏美术、视觉风格、色彩、光照、特效。"

name: game-audio-designer
description: Design or repair game music, sound effects, ambience, dialogue, spatial audio, mixing, and event feedback. 中文：游戏音效、背景音乐、配音、空间音频、混音。

name: game-balance-designer-expert
description: Design, diagnose, or tune combat, movement difficulty, progression, rewards, economies, and quantitative game rules. 中文：数值设计、平衡诊断、战斗数值、成长曲线、游戏经济、难度。

name: game-content-pipeline-engineer
description: Author the resources/content chapter in docs/GDD.md and choose resource representations from designed actions, state changes and composition; source, import or debug assets through Scene/UI into the runtime. Use the selected art/audio direction, not a new style. 中文：资源计划、设计行为到资源制法的选择、资源获取与导入、场景解析、运行时消费。

name: game-creative-director-expert
description: Use for game vision, player fantasy, emotional tone, theme-mechanic alignment, narrative direction, creative cohesion or production priorities. 中文：游戏创意、玩家幻想、主题、叙事、体验定位、制作取舍。

name: game-design-check
description: Review saved game-design decisions for an assigned design review or a concrete consistency, implementability or evidence question. Routine author self-check alone does not require this Skill. Not runtime acceptance. 中文：受托设计审查、具体设计矛盾与可实施性问题、定向修订核对。

name: game-feel-designer
description: Design or tune game control response, action rhythm, gameplay feedback and impact through coordinated animation, effects, camera, sound and supported haptics. Use for game feel, hit feedback and moment-to-moment responsiveness, not UI-only navigation or page transitions. 中文：操作手感、动作节奏、游玩反馈、打击感与冲击力。

name: game-implementation-planning
description: Plan an assigned implementation or architecture task, or resolve a concrete module/interface dependency. A general GDD platform choice alone does not require implementation planning. 中文：实现规划、受托技术架构、具体模块与接口依赖。

name: game-level-designer-expert
description: Design gameplay spaces, traversal, encounters, mechanic teaching and navigation; diagnose player guidance or level, round and quest progression. 中文：关卡与回合体验、玩家引导、路线与教学、空间可读性。

name: game-plan-execution
description: Execute or resume game implementation plans in the existing project, verifying basic correctness and preserving completed work. 中文：执行游戏实现计划、同工程续作、基础运行验证。

name: game-playtest-performance
description: Verify gameplay behavior, diagnose interaction or performance failures, and conduct explicitly requested experience validation with evidence and focused retests. 中文：基础运行验证、交互与性能诊断、受托体验验证与证据驱动复测。

name: game-systems-designer-expert
description: Design gameplay rules and core loops, or diagnose agency, repetition and learning through testable experience questions. Also covers progression, economy and state transitions when applicable. 中文：玩法系统、核心循环、选择与重复问题、可验证体验假设。

name: game-technical-artist
description: Prepare and integrate sprite-frame animation from supplied, sourced or AI-produced artwork, or implement and repair real-time game animation, VFX, materials, shaders and camera presentation against art and feedback designs. Use for dynamic visual execution, not art direction or resource loading alone. 中文：技术美术、AI精灵图动画、动画制作、特效实现、材质着色器、镜头表现、动态视觉。

name: game-ui-ux-designer
description: Design or repair non-XR game HUDs, menus, interface feedback and motion, navigation, gamepad focus, and input accessibility. For XR interfaces, use spatial UX. 中文：游戏界面、血条、菜单、界面切换与动效、手柄焦点、触屏布局。

name: gameplay-programmer
description: Design gameplay execution/state interfaces, or implement and diagnose movement, collision and update timing. Use for concrete gameplay execution questions, not general GDD authoring. 中文：玩法执行设计、状态接口、运动碰撞与更新时序。

name: root-cause-debugging
description: Systematic debugging and root-cause diagnosis for bugs, failed checks, or performance issues. 中文：故障排查、根因定位、测试失败、性能问题。

name: spatial-computing-game-expert
description: Design or diagnose XR, AR, and MR gameplay involving body movement, room constraints, tracking, anchoring, or comfort. For interface layout alone, use spatial UX. 中文：空间计算、体感玩法、房间尺度、VR与AR游戏。

name: spatial-computing-ux-designer-expert
description: Design or fix XR, AR, and MR interfaces involving spatial layout, gaze, gestures, controller focus, and ergonomic legibility. For non-XR screens, use game UI/UX. 中文：空间界面、注视交互、手势、XR界面布局。
